items.title: Bond Market Volatility Signals Risks for Corporate Debt Investors
items.content: Corporate bonds have been relatively resilient amid a global government bond selloff, but the strength may not last.
items.contentSnippet: Corporate bonds have been relatively resilient amid a global government bond selloff, but the strength may not last.
items.creator: Davide Barbuscia and Ronan Martin

summaries.zh: 企业债券在全球政府债券抛售期间表现相对稳健，但这一优势可能难以持续。当前债券市场波动加大，预示着企业债投资者面临潜在风险。
summaries.en: Corporate bonds have shown relative resilience despite a global government bond selloff, but this trend may not be sustainable. Bond market volatility signals potential risks for corporate debt investors, suggesting that the current stability could weaken. Investors should remain cautious as the market shifts.

items.title: Bangladesh Targets Up to $1 Billion in Debut Sovereign Bond Sale
items.content: Bangladesh is preparing to raise between $500 million and $1 billion through its maiden foreign-currency sovereign bond sale within the next three months, a senior government official said.
items.contentSnippet: Bangladesh is preparing to raise between $500 million and $1 billion through its maiden foreign-currency sovereign bond sale within the next three months, a senior government official said.
items.creator: Arun Devnath

summaries.zh: 孟加拉国计划在未来三个月内发行首笔外币主权债券，通过发行筹集500亿至100亿美元。该国高级政府官员表示，此次是该国首次发行此类债券。
summaries.en: Bangladesh plans to issue its first foreign-currency sovereign bond, aiming to raise between $500 million and $1 billion within three months, according to a senior government official. The sale marks the country's debut in this market.

items.title: Trump-Xi Summit Yields Coal Pledge as Tariff Talks Extend
items.content: China agreed to import at least 10 million metric tons of coal from the US next year and again in 2028, according to the White House, in a sign of progress in easing trade frictions.
items.contentSnippet: China agreed to import at least 10 million metric tons of coal from the US next year and again in 2028, according to the White House, in a sign of progress in easing trade frictions.
items.creator: Bloomberg News

summaries.zh: 白宫表示，中国同意在2027年和2028年分别从美国进口至少1000万吨煤炭，这标志着中美两大经济体贸易摩擦进一步缓和。
summaries.en: The White House reports that China has agreed to import at least 10 million metric tons of coal from the US in both 2027 and 2028. This agreement represents progress in easing trade tensions between the world's two largest economies.

items.title: US and China Seek Common Ground on AI
items.content: Bloomberg News Chief North Asia Correspondent Stephen Engle and ABC News State Department reporter Shannon Kingston tell Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping’s summit highlighted efforts to establish dialogue on AI while building trust between the two countries. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Engle and Kingston examine the significance of Xi’s state visit, China’s push to be treated as an equal to the US and the diplomatic signals surrounding the meetings. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: How Syracuse's Semiconductor Gamble May Help Save the Rust Belt
items.content: What does it actually take to bring a Rust Belt city back to life? Micron is building one of the largest semiconductor factories in US history in Syracuse, a city that experienced major job loss after companies including GE, Carrier and General Motors left the area. Rob Simpson of CenterState CEO explains what attracted Micron to the city, local business owner Darin Price talks about what the investment means on the ground, and Brookings economist Joseph Parilla makes the case that Syracuse could be a model for reindustrialization across America. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Birding Apps Bring More People Into the Wild
items.content: On Bloomberg This Weekend, writer and photographer Alexandra Marvar explains how apps such as Merlin are making birding easier and more accessible, helping draw new people to a hobby that offers an escape into nature. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Marvar also explores whether technology can remove some of the challenge, learning and satisfaction that traditionally come with identifying birds.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Mexico Stresses Sovereignty in US Cooperation
items.content: Mexico’s foreign minister Roberto Velasco Álvarez tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the country maintains a strong relationship with the US while insisting cooperation on security must respect Mexico’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, he says Mexico remains cautiously optimistic about ongoing trade negotiations as it seeks relief from US tariffs on automobiles and steel. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 墨西哥外长罗伯托·韦拉斯科·阿瓦雷斯表示，墨西哥与美国保持紧密关系，但强调美墨安全合作必须尊重墨西哥的主权和领土完整。他对正在进行的贸易谈判持谨慎乐观态度，希望缓解美国对汽车和钢材的关税。墨西哥同时维护自身利益，寻求平等合作。(约70字)
summaries.en: Mexico’s foreign minister, Roberto Velasco Álvarez, emphasized sovereignty in US cooperation, stressing that security cooperation must respect Mexico’s territorial integrity. He highlighted a strong but cautious relationship with the US, expressing optimism for ongoing trade negotiations aimed at reducing US tariffs on automobiles and steel. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Russia Ukraine War Becomes Economic Battle
items.content: New York Times Kyiv bureau chief Andrew Kramer tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Russia and Ukraine are increasingly targeting each other’s economies as the war shifts toward attacks on energy, transportation and export infrastructure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kramer says Ukraine is using its expanding drone arsenal to target Russia’s oil industry and its ability to finance a prolonged war. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 俄乌战争正演变为经济战。据《纽约时报》基辅分社首席记者安德鲁·克莱默向彭博社表示，双方正越来越多地针对彼此经济，通过攻击能源、交通和出口基础设施。克莱默指出，乌克兰正利用其不断扩大的无人机库，打击俄罗斯的石油产业及其长期战争融资能力。
summaries.en: The Russia-Ukraine war has evolved into an economic battle, with both sides targeting energy, transportation, and export infrastructure. Ukraine is using its drone capabilities to strike Russia’s oil industry and hinder its financial ability to sustain the conflict. This shift reflects the war’s growing economic dimensions.

items.title: McDonald’s Selloff Hits 30% as Big Mac Inflation Spurs Pushback
items.content: McDonald’s Corp. faces a key challenge as it fights to reinvigorate a sagging stock price: Winning back the cost-conscious diners who believe its menu has become too expensive.
items.contentSnippet: McDonald’s Corp. faces a key challenge as it fights to reinvigorate a sagging stock price: Winning back the cost-conscious diners who believe its menu has become too expensive.
items.creator: Peyton Forte

summaries.zh: 麦当劳股价面临挑战，公司需重新吸引因菜单价格过高而流失的精打细算的消费者。随着巨无霸汉堡价格的上涨，消费者对麦当劳的抵制情绪加剧，公司正努力应对这一问题以提振股价。
summaries.en: McDonald’s Corp. is experiencing a 30% stock price decline amid rising menu costs, particularly for its Big Mac. The company faces challenges in regaining investor confidence and attracting cost-conscious consumers who perceive its offerings as overpriced. The inflationary pressures on its menu are prompting consumer pushback, impacting its financial performance and market valuation.

items.title: Higher Bond Yields Mark a Return to Normal
items.content: Ritholtz Wealth Management founder Barry Ritholtz tells Bloomberg This Weekend that rising bond yields reflect both a normalization of interest rates and inflationary pressures from factors including tariffs and higher energy prices. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ritholtz says higher yields have made fixed income more attractive while investors should consider whether strong equity gains have pushed their portfolios away from their intended allocations. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Ritholtz Wealth Management founder Barry Ritholtz tells Bloomberg This Weekend that rising bond yields reflect both a normalization of interest rates and inflationary pressures from factors including tariffs and higher energy prices. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ritholtz says higher yields have made fixed income more attractive while investors should consider whether strong equity gains have pushed their portfolios away from their intended allocations. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 债券收益率上升标志着利率正常化和通胀压力（包括关税和能源价格上涨）的共同影响。Ritholtz Wealth Management创始人Barry Ritholtz表示，高收益率使固定收益更具吸引力，投资者需评估股票收益是否导致投资组合偏离预定配置。来源：彭博。
summaries.en: Rising bond yields indicate a return to normal interest rates and inflationary pressures from tariffs and higher energy prices, according to Barry Ritholtz of Ritholtz Wealth Management. He notes that higher yields make fixed income more attractive and advises investors to assess whether strong equity gains have shifted their portfolio allocations from their intended targets. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Northeast Faces Wind, Rain and Coastal Flooding
items.content: Bloomberg News meteorologist Craig Allen tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the nor'easter will bring waves of heavy rain and strong winds to the Northeast, along with risks from falling trees, localized flooding and dangerous coastal conditions. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Allen says coastal flooding could affect Long Island, the Jersey Shore, Connecticut and Massachusetts as rough ocean conditions persist through multiple high-tide cycles. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Bloomberg News meteorologist Craig Allen tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the nor'easter will bring waves of heavy rain and strong winds to the Northeast, along with risks from falling trees, localized flooding and dangerous coastal conditions. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Allen says coastal flooding could affect Long Island, the Jersey Shore, Connecticut and Massachusetts as rough ocean conditions persist through multiple high-tide cycles. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 东北将面临风、雨和沿海洪水。气象学家克雷格·艾伦表示，东北将出现强风和暴雨，伴随树木倒塌、局部洪水和危险的沿海条件。沿海洪水可能影响长岛、新泽西海岸、康涅狄格州和马萨诸塞州，因恶劣海况将持续多轮高潮。
summaries.en: A nor'easter is expected to impact the Northeast with heavy rain, strong winds, and coastal flooding. Meteorologist Craig Allen warns of risks including falling trees, localized flooding, and dangerous coastal conditions. Coastal flooding may affect Long Island, the Jersey Shore, Connecticut, and Massachusetts due to rough ocean conditions during high tides. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Iran War Endgame Remains Elusive
items.content: Bloomberg Mideast geoeconomics lead Dina Esfandiary tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a protracted Iran war, marked by cycles of escalation and pauses in fighting, is a key scenario as deep divisions over the Strait of Hormuz complicate diplomacy. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Esfandiary says Gulf Arab states are pressing to avoid further escalation as they seek to limit the economic and security damage from the conflict.  (Source: Bloomberg)

Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Esfandiary says Gulf Arab states are pressing to avoid further escalation as they seek to limit the economic and security damage from the conflict. summaries.zh: 伊朗与周边国家冲突持续，呈现周期性升级与停火交替态势。霍尔木兹海峡问题加剧分歧，外交陷入僵局。海湾阿拉伯国家为避免经济与安全受损，正力促局势降温。据彭博报道，彭博中东地缘经济首席分析师丁娜·埃斯凡迪里表示，长期冲突是关键情景。
summaries.en: A protracted Iran war, characterized by cycles of escalation and pauses, is a key scenario due to deep divisions over the Strait of Hormuz, complicating diplomacy, according to Bloomberg's Dina Esfandiary. Gulf Arab states are pressing to avoid further escalation to limit economic and security damage from the conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: The China Trade Problem That Tariffs Alone Can't Fix
items.content: China ran a $1.2 trillion trade surplus last year, many of its companies don't need to make a profit, and its exports are growing at two to three times the rate of the global economy. Michael Froman, former US Trade Representative under President Obama and now president of the Council on Foreign Relations, tells us why Xi Jinping sees a consumer-led economy as a political threat, and what happens when China finally runs out of countries willing to buy. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Trump Xi Summit Leaves Big Issues Unresolved
items.content: Bloomberg North Asia correspondent Stephen Engle tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping bought more time to negotiate over trade while major disagreements involving Taiwan, Iran and technology remain. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Engle explains how competition over AI and unresolved economic and security issues are shaping the next phase of US-China relations. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 特朗普与习近平峰会未能解决重大分歧。据彭博北亚记者Stephen Engle分析，峰会为贸易谈判争取了时间，但台湾、伊朗和技术等关键问题仍悬而未决。Engle指出，人工智能竞争及未解决的经济与安全问题将影响中美关系的下一阶段。

items.title: Billionaire Charoen’s Asset World Targets $1 Billion REIT IPO
items.content: Asset World Corp Pcl’s new Thai Real Estate Investment Trust aims to raise at least $1 billion through a listing as it seeks funds to expand its hotel and commercial property business, according to a senior executive.
items.contentSnippet: Asset World Corp Pcl’s new Thai Real Estate Investment Trust aims to raise at least $1 billion through a listing as it seeks funds to expand its hotel and commercial property business, according to a senior executive.
items.creator: Anuchit Nguyen

summaries.zh: 资产世界公司计划通过发行泰国房地产投资信托基金（REIT）筹集至少10亿美元，以支持其酒店和商业地产业务的扩张。据公司高管透露，此次IPO旨在为业务发展提供资金。
summaries.en: Asset World Corp Pcl plans to launch a Thai Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) with an initial public offering (IPO) targeting at least $1 billion. The company aims to raise funds to expand its hotel and commercial property business. The REIT will focus on financing growth in these sectors. The announcement was made by a senior executive, highlighting the company's strategy for capital acquisition. The move underscores Asset World's commitment to leveraging REITs for business expansion.

items.title: Blackstone Cements Shift From Star Dealmakers With Baratta Exit
items.content: If there was any doubt that Jon Gray is now the center of gravity at Blackstone Inc., the past few weeks have erased it.
items.contentSnippet: If there was any doubt that Jon Gray is now the center of gravity at Blackstone Inc., the past few weeks have erased it.
items.creator: Preeti Singh and Dawn Lim

summaries.zh: 布莱克石集团（Blackstone）正从明星交易撮合人的角色转型，董事长巴塔（Baratta）的离任凸显了这一变化。近期事件表明，琼·格雷（Jon Gray）已成为公司核心人物。
summaries.en: Jon Gray has become the central figure at Blackstone Inc., signaling a shift away from the firm's previous focus on star dealmakers like Matt Baratta. This change reflects a strategic realignment within Blackstone, though specific details on the transition are limited. The article highlights Gray's rising prominence, indicating a potential reevaluation of Blackstone's leadership and deal-making approach.

items.content: SK Hynix Inc.’s Solidigm is considering a US initial public offering as soon as next year, according to people familiar with the matter.

summaries.en: SK Hynix's Solidigm is reportedly planning a US initial public offering (IPO) as early as 2027, according to informed sources. The company is evaluating the possibility of going public in the United States.
